title: clientValidation.ts `theme:` entry reads `spec.ThemeSchema`, which the spec retired — dangling dynamic read on a metadata type that is not registered
body:
Found while executing #5710 (session `session_01EuPCi56cnGyykygi3z9w4m`, PR #5713). Filed unassigned, out of that card's fence (`packages/app-shell/**` was hard out-of-scope there; a sibling card was live in the package).

## Measurement

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/clientValidation.ts:590`:

```ts
theme: async () => (await import('@objectstack/spec/ui')).ThemeSchema as unknown as ZodLikeSchema,
```

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#10485 (PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#10695) retired the spec's whole `ui/theme.zod.ts` module: on objectstack `origin/main` `95437e7`, `ThemeSchema` has 0 exports under `packages/spec/src/ui/` (controls `PageSchema`/`FormViewSchema` return live hits on the same pipeline).
- Against the framework tree, this line yields `undefined` cast to `ZodLikeSchema` at runtime — a crash (or a silent validation no-op, depending on the caller's null handling) the moment the `theme` entry is invoked.
- It is **invisible to objectstack's Console Pin Gate**: a namespace property access is not a named import binding, so the bundler resolves the dynamic import fine and never checks the property; the tsc deps build compiles against objectui's own `@objectstack/spec` 17.1.0 pin, which still publishes the symbol. So no gate will ever announce this.
- It is currently **unreachable**: the spec's retirement rationale (objectstack#10485) records that `theme` was never a registered metadata type, so metadata-admin should never hit this validator entry. Precedent for pruning stale entries in this file: #3561 (closed).

## Suggested shape

Remove the `theme:` entry (dead key pointing at a deleted upstream symbol), or — if metadata-admin genuinely intends a theme editing surface — that is a capability decision that needs its own ruling, not a validator entry pointing at a symbol that no longer exists. Note the file sits in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`, not in the `app-shell/src/console/**` fence of #5619.

Refs: #5710 · PR #5713 · objectstack-ai/objectstack#10485 · objectstack-ai/objectstack#10856
